doc: Evaluated mechanically by eval/flies_score.py. r = iid prevalence-matched reference of the SAME scored frames (expected frame F1 = pooled prevalence). r_b = oracle bout-placement reference (each movie's GT bouts, same count and durations, random non-overlapping positions; mean one-to-one any-overlap bout F1 over 200 draws). Bar = max(times_ref * r, r + plus_ref). A check passes iff point >= bar AND movie-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > lower bar (strict) AND the CI is informative (<= 5% undefined resamples). Bouts = maximal runs of the unexcluded masks, censored at unknown frames, matched one-to-one with maximum cardinality.

decision_tree.lunge_gate: purpose gate-lunge, split dev = movies 1-2 only, mid5, 30 fps, behaviors wing_threat+lunge, one execution, frozen pipeline config
decision_tree.wing_gate: purpose gate-wing, split train = movies 1-5 (no subset), the branch's window/fps/behaviors, same frozen config, one execution, by the deadline
decision_tree.wing_NO-GO: no fly F1 claim of any kind (wing threat or lunge); qualitative demo clip only; the scorer refuses the fly test split
decision_tree.wing_GO: test run(s) on movies 6-10 with the branch's window/fps/behaviors and the same frozen config; test-1 is the primary result

wing_threat.source: Aniket 2026-10-28: if wing threat isn't clearly above the random floor on the training split by end of Oct 31 ET, ship it as a qualitative demo clip with no F1 claim. 'Clearly above' operationalized by the evaluator (not separately approved by Aniket).

lunge.source: ADR-002 (b): SAM sees 2 flies in >= 90% of samples AND rule bout-level recall >= 0.5 on train; evaluator adds the bout-F1 and frame-F1 guards

lunge.only_if: lunge gate GO (enforced: lunge is scored on test only in the GO branch)
